summary: A 2.4 redundant controller and hub deployment (2 controllers, 2 hubs, hop node, 2 execution nodes, external PostgreSQL 15, HAProxy in front of controller and hub) becomes the 2.6 enterprise topology with 2 gateway, 2 hub and 2 EDA VMs with colocated Redis, 2 controllers, hop and execution nodes, external PostgreSQL 15, and the load balancer in front of platform gateway.
questions: What VMs do I need to upgrade a redundant controller and hub to 2.6?
